0022600177.text: The Chicago Bulls, 1-6 overall and 1-4 on the road, visit the 3-4 New York Knicks on a five-game losing streak, sitting 13th in the East while New York is 8th and riding a one-game winning streak. The Bulls trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 133-127 loss in Chicago on October 28, and they lost the 2025-26 series 1-3. Nic Claxton is out for Chicago with a hamstring injury, and Jalen Smith is day-to-day with a finger injury and listed as a game-time decision, while Josh Hart is day-to-day with an ankle injury for New York and also a game-time decision.
